files.rationale: Register the missing <Route path="/tasks/:taskId"> for TaskDetailPage.jsx -- it already existed, fully built and styled, but was never wired into routing, so every task link on /tasks rendered a completely blank page.

summary: Fix: /tasks/:taskId rendered a completely blank page (which looked like "missing styles") because TaskDetailPage.jsx was never registered as a route in App.jsx, even though TaskflowHomePage.jsx already links to specific task URLs. Added the missing <Route> + import. Verified with a real browser screenshot: the page now renders fully styled with no JS errors.
